title: Battery Recovery After Shore Power
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading shore_power_state=*
| stats avg(battery_voltage) as avg_voltage, latest(battery_soc_pct) as latest_soc by shore_power_state
| sort shore_power_state
description: Compares battery recovery when shore power is on versus off.
value: This turns battery confidence from a guess into a measurable before-and-after view.
implementation: Send battery voltage and SOC readings with shore-power state tags to `index=personal`; compare recovery metrics.
visualization: Grouped battery table for shore-power on and off states.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether the batteries really recover the way you expect when shore power is connected.
